deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It is the end of a pencil draft of a formal letter by Riemann, with several deletions. It was written on the back of a sheet whose other side (100r) begins a private letter dated 'Leipzig[?] den 24 September 1858' and carries a stray formula dx/dq = x. That places the draft around September 1858, when Riemann was travelling.

Content, in approximate reconstruction:
- Riemann asks a person addressed formally ('Sie', 'Ihnen') for permission to go somewhere, apparently to visit or see something (a collection or institution), 'ohne Sie zu stören' (without disturbing you).
- In a struck-out sentence he says he could avoid this request (or this trouble) if the addressee would notify in advance a secretary or attendant (reading uncertain: 'einen Sekretair oder einen Stubenwärter[?]') of his request.
- He closes with a formal courtesy formula ('Mich Ihrem/Ihnen allerseits ... empfehlend[?], verbleibe ich ergebenst') and signs 'B. Riemann'.
- 'Schwerin.' appears at the lower left, as the addressee or the place of writing. 'Schwerin den ...' is begun at the bottom as a place-and-date line.

This is a request for access, perhaps to a library, archive or collection in Schwerin, during his 1858 travels.

The next page (101) is unrelated to this text. It contains Riemann's working on the transverse vibrations of an elastic rectangular plate with free edges:
- the energy functional with the Poisson-type constant θ;
- the equation Δ²w = μ⁴ w;
- Kirchhoff-type free-edge boundary conditions, including the corner condition w_xy = 0.
None of that appears on 100v.

There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically here.

results.what: Draft of a formal letter requesting permission or access (apparently in Schwerin, c. September 1858), signed B. Riemann

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a non-mathematical letter draft (a polite request for access, with closing formula and signature). It has minor biographical interest only, for Riemann's 1858 travels and a possible visit to Schwerin. There is no mathematical content.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'Sie[?] zu nennen[?] ... zu laßen[?]' is very uncertain. The image is more compatible with something like 'die Sammlung[?] ... zu besehen[?]', and the clause continues 'so darf ich, ohne Sie zu stören, doch hin...gehen[?]'.
Line 3: 'Diese Ausgabe[?]' may rather be 'Diese Anfrage[?]' (this request). 'ersparen' is plausible. 'vielleicht' is an interlinear insertion above 'einen'.

Line 4: 'Stubenwärter[?]' is doubtful; another attendant/official title (e.g. a library servant) is possible. 'von meiner Bitte vorher benachrichtigen wollten' is plausible, and the whole sentence (lines 3-4) is struck through.

Line 5: 'Indem ich' is struck out. The rest reads approximately 'Mich Ihrem/Ihnen allerseits[?] ... empfehlend[?]', though the word read 'empfehlend' could instead be '...entgegensehend'. Then 'verbleibe ich'.
'Schwerin.' at lower left is a separate notation (addressee or place), not part of the signature. 'Schwerin den ...' at the bottom is an unfinished place/date line.
